ui.counter: You spotted the tell! It's super effective!

tell.urgency: Urgency: real banks give you time.
tell.fake_link: Links in SMS: banks never send them for KYC.
tell.ask_otp: OTP request: nobody genuine ever needs it.
tell.friendly: Too friendly, too fast: a stranger in a hurry.
tell.scan_to_receive: "Scan to receive": scanning is for paying.
tell.ask_pin: PIN to receive: a PIN only ever sends money.
tell.greed: Pay that's too good for the work.
tell.social_proof: "Everyone earned": fake proof is easy to make.
tell.fear: Fear: panic makes you act before you think.
tell.authority: Fake authority: names and IDs are easy to invent.
tell.instant: Instant money with no questions has a hidden price.
tell.no_checks: No checks means no rules protecting you.
tell.permissions: Contact and photo access is used for harassment.
tell.scarcity: "Last chance tonight": pressure to stop you thinking.
tell.recruit: Recruitment bonuses: new money pays old members.

urgency.line: "Dear customer, your account will be BLOCKED in 2 HOURS!"
urgency.b: Real banks don't threaten by SMS. Stay calm.

fake_link.a: Don't tap. I'll use the official app or branch.
fake_link.b: Tap the link and fill the form
fake_link.c: Forward it to a friend to check

ask_otp.line: "Enter the OTP you just received to complete KYC."
ask_otp.a: Ignore it and hope it stops
ask_otp.c: Never share an OTP. Delete and report the SMS.

friendly.line: "Hey friend! I LOVE your old cycle. ₹1,500, deal? I'm in a hurry!"
friendly.b: Slow down. How will you pay me?

scan_to_receive.line: "I'm sending a QR code. Scan it to RECEIVE your ₹1,500!"
scan_to_receive.b: Ask him to send cash instead
scan_to_receive.c: I never scan to receive. Send it to my UPI ID.

ask_pin.line: "Arre, just enter your PIN, then the money comes in!"
ask_pin.a: A PIN only sends money. No deal.
ask_pin.c: Enter a wrong PIN to be safe

greed.line: "PART-TIME JOB! ₹5,000 a day just for liking videos!"
greed.a: That's far too much pay for that work.

social_proof.line: "Look at these screenshots: 400 students earned today!"
social_proof.a: Ask Kabir if he's heard of it
social_proof.c: Wow, they look real. I'm in!

fee.line: "Pay ₹500 registration to unlock your first task!"
fee.c: Real jobs pay me. Block and report.

fear.line: "Someone is using your card RIGHT NOW! You'll lose everything!"
fear.a: Oh no! What do I do?!
fear.b: Take a breath. Panic is what scammers want.

authority.line: "I'm Officer Sharma, Paisapur Bank fraud team, employee ID 4471."
authority.a: Anyone can say that. I'll call the bank myself.
authority.c: An ID number! He must be real.

ask_otp.line: "Read me the OTP we just sent, so I can block the card."
ask_otp.c: Hang up and call the number on my card.

instant.line: "₹5,000 in your account in 5 minutes! Instantly!"
instant.b: Instant money usually hides a huge cost.

no_checks.line: "No documents, no credit check, no questions!"
no_checks.a: A real lender follows rules. Is this one registered?
no_checks.c: Ask if they need a photo

permissions.line: "Just allow access to your contacts and photos. Formality!"
permissions.c: No app needs my contacts to lend. Walk away.

guarantee.a: Nothing honest guarantees doubling. Where do returns come from?

social_proof.line: "Half of Paisapur has joined! Even your friend Kabir!"
social_proof.b: Early members get paid with new members' money.
social_proof.c: If Kabir joined, it must be fine!

scarcity.line: "Offer closes TONIGHT. Decide now or miss out forever!"
scarcity.c: A real investment won't vanish overnight. No.

recruit.line: "Bring three friends and get a ₹1,000 bonus each!"
recruit.a: Bonuses for recruiting: that's a pyramid. I'm reporting this.
recruit.b: Tell him you'll think about it
